turns.question: How do I add a YouTube video?

links.title: How to Use YouTube with OptiSigns

result.text:
OptiBot

To add a YouTube video to OptiSigns, follow these steps:

Go to Files/Assets in the OptiSigns portal and select Apps.
Search for and select the YouTube app.
Enter an asset Name and paste your public or unlisted video link into the URL field.
(Optional) Configure Display Options (Mute, Captions) or Playback Options (Start At, End At).
Click Save, then assign the created YouTube asset to a Screen, Playlist, or Schedule.

turns.question: How do I set up my first screen with OptiSigns?

links.title: Set Up Add or Unpair a Screen

result.text:
OptiBot

To set up your first screen with OptiSigns, follow these steps:

Install the OptiSigns App: Download and install the OptiSigns app on your player device, then open it to get your pairing code.
Pair Your Screen: Log in to your account at app.optisigns.com, navigate to the Screens page, click Add Screen, enter the pairing code shown on your display (note that codes are case-sensitive), and click Pair.
Upload Content: Go to Files/Assets, click Upload Files, and upload your desired files or media.
Push Content to Screen: Open the menu on your uploaded file, select Push To Screens, choose your screen, and click Push.

turns.question: How do I create a playlist with images and videos?

links.title: How to Manage and Edit Your Playlist Settings

result.text:
OptiBot

To create a playlist with images and videos in OptiSigns:

Navigate to Playlists on the top navigation bar and click Create Playlist (or New).
Name your playlist so it is easy to identify.
Drag and drop your images and videos into the playlist, or select assets from your Files/Assets panel and click Add Selected Items to Playlist.
Adjust item durations by clicking the pencil icon or duration number next to each asset.
Click Push to Screens at the top of your playlist to deploy the content to your screen(s) immediately or on a schedule.

turns.question: How do I schedule a playlist for weekdays from 9 AM to 6 PM?

links.title: Creating and Using Schedules with OptiSigns

result.text:
OptiBot

To schedule a playlist for weekdays from 9 AM to 6 PM in OptiSigns, follow these steps:

Create a Schedule: Go to the Schedules tab on the top navigation bar and click Create Schedule.
Add an Event: Click Add Event, select your playlist, and set the time from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Set Recurrence: Under the recurrence settings, select Repeat Weekly and check the days for Monday through Friday.
Save & Assign: Click Save to finalize the schedule, then assign it to your screen(s) via the Screens tab or by using Push to Screen.

turns.question: How do I assign the same playlist to multiple screens?

result.text:
OptiBot

You can assign the same playlist to multiple screens using two methods:

Group Edit (Screens Management): Go to Screens Management, select the checkbox next to each screen, click Edit, set Type to Playlist, choose your playlist, and click Save.
Push to Screens (Playlists Page): Go to the Playlists page, click Push to Screens next to your playlist, select the target screens, and choose your push option (Push immediately, Schedule Changes, or Temp Takeover).

turns.question: What should I check when my OptiSigns screen is offline?

links.title: OptiSigns Pro ProMax Player Troubleshooting Guide

result.text:
OptiBot

When your OptiSigns screen appears offline in the portal, it is typically due to a network connection issue. Here are the key steps to check and troubleshoot:

Mobile Hotspot or Alternate Network: Try connecting the device to a mobile hotspot or a different Wi-Fi network. If it connects successfully, the issue is with your primary Wi-Fi network.
Ethernet Connection: Plug an Ethernet cable directly into the device to check if it can re-establish a connection.
Firewall Settings: Verify that your network firewall is not blocking OptiSigns and that the required URLs, IP addresses, and ports are whitelisted.
Troubleshooting Page (Pro/ProMax): Check the network status box on the Troubleshooting Page. Green text means there are no network issues, while red text indicates a specific error.
Factory Reset: If connection attempts fail, perform a Factory Reset on the device and complete the initial setup again.

If your device still cannot connect to any network after trying these steps, please reach out to our support team.

turns.question: How do I use Split Screen to show content in different zones?

links.title: How to Create and Use the Split Screen App

result.text:
OptiBot

To use the Split Screen app to show content in different zones, follow these steps:

Create the App: Go to Files/Assets > App in the portal and select Split Screen.
Select a Template: Choose a pre-made template or build a custom layout.
Configure Zones: Name your Split Screen layout and adjust the size/position of each zone by dragging its edges or changing the dimension settings.
Assign Content: Select each zone and choose the content you want to play inside it (such as an asset, playlist, or schedule).
Save & Assign: Click Save, then navigate to the Screens tab, edit your target screen, and set its content to your newly created Split Screen asset.
